newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds see some nearby activity in afternoon.
newsitem.headline: European feeds see some nearby activity in afternoon.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market saw some nearby activity this afternoon as lower seller prices attracted buying interest, market sources said.
"After a dull period the easier price levels, mainly for mid-protein products, and a slightly easier dollar sparked some demand for nearby material," one broker said.

Nearby afloat Brazilian soymeal pellets traded at $303 and $304 a tonne cif Rotterdam on fears of tightness due to a gap of arrivals into Europe. Argentine soymeal pellets traded at $283 a tonne cif Rotterdam.
Jan/March Argentine sunmeal pellets changed hands at $155 a tonne cif Rotterdam.
September EU rapemeal traded between 27.75 and 28 marks per 100 kg fob lower Rhine and Oct at 28 marks fob.

"Nearby rapemeal remained relatively firm on fears of tight supplies as crushers have not enough rapeseed because seed sellers were unwilling to part from their material, expecting seed prices to rise further," one broker said.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
